text.p: These are the leading stories in the Namibian press on Tuesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- An investigation into claims of an illegal seal meat project appears to have stalled. A report on allegations that a sealer in Henties Bay had breached health regulations was presented to President Sam Nujoma, but he has not yet decided on any action.

- Horse mackerel trawlers at Walvis Bay have reported an improvement in pilchard stocks in Namibian waters, raising hopes that the cabinet might reverse an earlier decision to suspend pilchard quotas this year.
